T: A family secret and a wedding banquet.
D: A Chinese-American woman travels to China, where her family has organised a fake wedding to say goodbye to their grandmother.
P: Serve the main at the wedding banquet.
S: the family making dumplings around Nai Nai's table

Pork, cabbage and ginger dumplings pan-fried until crisp on the bottom, with a black vinegar, soy and chilli oil dipping sauce. Salt 200g finely chopped wombok for 10 minutes and squeeze dry. Mix with 400g pork mince, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 sliced spring onions, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 30 round dumpling wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Fry in 2 tbsp oil for 2 minutes until golden underneath, add 100ml water, cover and steam 6 minutes until dry. Mix 3 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp chilli oil for dipping.
Changchun smashed cucumber with chilli oil

Cold smashed cucumbers in a punchy dressing of garlic, black vinegar, soy and chilli oil, topped with toasted sesame and coriander. Lay 4 Lebanese cucumbers on a board and smash with the flat of a knife until they split, then cut into bite-size chunks. Toss with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar and drain in a sieve for 15 minutes. Mix 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil and 2 tbsp chilli oil. Toss the cucumbers in the dressing and top with toasted sesame seeds and coriander.
M: Wedding banquet crispy sweet and sour pork
Hao Hao's wedding banquet for Nai Nai

Northeast Chinese style crispy pork in a glossy tangy sauce with capsicum, pineapple and carrot, served with steamed jasmine rice. Cut 600g pork scotch fillet into thin slices, season and toss in 1 egg white, then in 100g potato starch. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes, rest, then fry again for 1 minute until very crisp. Stir-fry 1 capsicum, 1 julienned carrot, 2 garlic cloves and 150g pineapple chunks for 2 minutes. Add 4 tbsp rice vinegar, 4 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour in 60ml water and bubble until glossy. Toss in the pork and serve with 300g rice.
W: the sweet course at the wedding banquet

Chewy glutinous rice balls filled with sweet red bean paste, rolled in sesame seeds and fried until puffed, golden and crisp. Mix 250g glutinous rice flour with 60g caster sugar, then stir in about 200ml hot water and knead to a smooth, soft dough. Divide into 16 balls. Flatten each, fill with 1 tsp red bean paste from a 200g tin and roll closed. Wet lightly and roll in 80g white sesame seeds. Fry in oil at 160C for 6 to 8 minutes, pressing gently against the side of the pot so they puff, until golden.
K: Nai Nai's iced jasmine lychee tea
Nai Nai's tea at the family table

Fragrant jasmine tea brewed gently, chilled with lychee syrup and lime and served over ice with whole lychees. Steep 4 jasmine tea bags in 1L water just off the boil for 3 minutes, then remove the bags and cool. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping 150ml syrup. Stir the syrup and the juice of 1 lime into the tea and chill. Fill 4 glasses with ice and a few lychees and pour over the tea.
